incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx for tenant "acme-corp" on /v1/stream (gateway-vpc-us-east). error rate 18% over 5m, median latency 2.3s, seen 504s. triggered at 2026-03-15T09:12:28Z
sarah: paging @mike @jordan - Acme reporting streaming disconnects. user-facing 504s, clients retrying. their support Slack linked.
mike: on it. first glance: gateway proxy returning 502/504 with upstream RSTs. dedicated pool for acme near capacity, lots of queued requests. logs: https://logs.local/replay/abcd
jordan: confirmed high conn counts on gateway workers, KV cache pressure rising. dedicated instances at ~92% CPU, some threads hung waiting on upstream. looks like their app-gateway is closing idle conns aggressively.
sarah: acme-oncall, can you confirm any recent deploys or LB changes?
acme-oncall: yes, we had a service deploy ~09:05 and our infra team rolled a new nginx+envoy config. started seeing failures right after. we're rolling back now but need a short-term mitigation.
mike: likely idle timeout mismatch + aggressive client retries causing thundering herd. mitigation plan (short-term):
- ask acme to bump LB idle_timeout to 120s on their side
- increase proxy_read_timeout / keepalive on our gateway for their tenant
- scale their dedicated pool (+4 nodes) while rollback completes
- temporarily reduce max client retries at our edge to avoid amplification
ryan: submitted scale request to Dedicated autoscaler for tenant acme-corp: +4 nodes (request id sa-8721). ETA ~90s for new nodes to join.
deploy-bot: autoscaler job queued: dedicated-pool/acme-corp scale 12 -> 16 (job #4523).
jordan: pushing quick patch to gateway config to increase timeouts and cap retries:
```
kubectl -n gateway patch configmap acme-proxy --type merge -p '{"data":{"proxy_read_timeout":"120s","max_retries":"2"}}'
```
apply in 1m.
sarah: oncall handoff in 15m; @mike will take next if any regression. I'm staying on for the rollback.
mike: looking at pcap, we see TCP RST from upstream after ~30s idle on many flows -> idle timeout mismatch confirmed. pinged acme infra to raise their LB timeout.
acme-oncall: LB timeout increased to 120s and change is live. running synthetic streams now. first test looks better.
sarah: metrics update: error rate dropping to ~4% over last 2m, tail latency normalizing. keeping watch on connection counts.
mike: follow-ups / action items: (1) postmortem and timeline (2) add detector for upstream idle timeout mismatch (heuristic: upstream RSTs + short-lived 5xx spike) (3) per-tenant connection caps and soft-fallback route (4) enterprise onboarding doc: explicit LB keepalive/timeout guidance. I'll own (1) and (4).
jordan: I'll perform a rolling restart of the gateway pods serving acme to clear any stuck fds and ensure the patched config is active. doing rolling restart now.
acme-oncall: after restart and LB changes our integration tests show stable streams. thanks for quick response. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident severity: Sev2 -> Mitigated. Duration 00:24:51. Mitigation summary: increased LB idle timeout, raised proxy_read_timeout, scaled dedicated pool, limited retries. Retrospective tasks assigned. Channel will be archived in 1h."
